problem_type: Model selection scope does not match a multi-mode editor
symptom: Reference-only models lose their original editor slots; Agent presentation can reach confirmation without a required reference or omit the selected reference when projecting a shot into its node.
direct_cause: StoryboardPlanEditor and presentStoryboard request default text_to_video/text_to_image projections; reference-only models disappear before row mode resolution, required-slot validation and reference projection.
class_root: Multi-mode storyboard consumers must request all published modes from the shared catalog; a default single-mode query cannot preserve the model contract used to validate and project author references.
affected_population: Legacy and Run storyboard hosts using image_to_video-only or image_edit-only models from any vendor
entry_points: Original storyboard video model list and reference slots
Original storyboard image model list and reference slots
Agent presentStoryboard through original row actions, materializer, confirmation and runner
internal_only_reason: Internal catalog publication contract and original editor rendering; no dependency API or layout changes.
invariants: Any-published queries retain every usable published row of the requested media kind exactly once.
Default and explicit task-mode queries retain their original publication filtering.
Unavailable or unpublished rows never become selectable.
Original editor and reference controls remain the only rendering owners.
Agent presentation resolves the published shot mode before required-reference validation and node projection; selected author references replace stale node references.

door_reduction.why_not: The cache and hook own projection/lifecycle; payment, canvas adapters, costs, shot-table and settings keep their own task-specific queries. Agent availableModels unions explicit modes. Original storyboard editor and Agent presentation require any-published scope because both consume multi-mode author plans.

generality_proof: One explicit query scope in the original cache applies the same availability/publication filter to image and video rows for both storyboard hosts, independent of vendor or model identity.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select published task scope before one existing DTO-to-option projection and cache.
Carry explicit scope through original reactive catalog lifecycle.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Original-entry regression retains real catalog projection, runtime derivation, row actions, materializer, confirmation and runner: missing first frame must not confirm; explicit binding must reach executor instead of stale node URL.
Real Electron first-frame v2 executes the requested image_to_video-only model while screenshots still show a generic reference entry; new original-page assertion requires first_frame.
Same default-only call excludes image_edit-only; the existing catalog regression supplies both populations through IPC DTOs.
Explicit/default task-mode calls retain existing filtering; no caller changed.

recurrence.reason: Every reference-only published model and either original storyboard host can reproduce the same omission.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs preloadModelOptions useModelOptionsState; followed StoryboardShotTable to StoryboardShotRow resolveShotArchetypeMode and ShotReferenceZone.
Read modelCatalogCache.test.ts and availableModels.ts: Agent discovery unions modes, but presentStoryboard separately queried defaults and lost reference-only modes before deriving rows.
git diff 96d368c26 -- src/config/modelCatalogCache.ts src/config/useModelOptions.ts was empty before repair; original Editor default calls also predate this branch.

prevention.invariant: Explicit editor scope includes reference-only published models without changing single-mode callers.
prevention.failure_mode: Existing availability and nonempty publication checks fail closed.
prevention.strategy: Extend original query type with any-published; include it in the existing cache key and pass it from original editor and Agent presentation, with no duplicate catalog/state or execution path.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unsuitable default-scope calls in the original editor and Agent presentation, preserving task-specific callers.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application-owned model query and UI projection; no framework behavior change.

migration: No persisted fields, model defaults, page structure or execution semantics change.
residual_risks: Pending real Electron first-frame slot rerun, build and both-host acceptance; Windows remains unverified.
A successful loopback journey does not prove real-provider reliability or the unrelated T7 native resource retry.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The original catalog projection owns publication filtering for every caller.
